description: An eight-stage shift register with a gate output for every stage, a serial output and four voltages mixed from the stage pattern

inputs.text: Shifts the register along one stage on each rise above 1V, and works out the four CV voltages afresh
Puts a 1 into the first stage if it is above 1V at the moment of a clock
Puts a 1 into the first stage if it is above 1V at the moment of a clock; while a cable is here the register's own feedback is switched out
Freezes the eight stage outputs and the four CV outputs while the voltage here is above 1V, although the register keeps shifting underneath

outputs.text: 5V while the first stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the second stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the third stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the fourth stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the fifth stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the sixth stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the seventh stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the eighth stage of the shift register holds a 1, and 0V while it holds a 0
5V while the bit leaving the end of the register is a 1; it keeps following the register while STR is high, which the eight stage outputs do not
A stepped voltage, 0V when the four stages feeding it are all low and a little under 5V when they are all high; each of those four stages adds its own fixed weight

notes: with only a clock patched the register feeds itself: a 1 goes in whenever the bit at the end differs from the bit at the start, so the pattern keeps changing and never settles.
the register comes up with a 1 in the first stage and 0 in the other seven, so one stage output is already at 5V before any clock arrives.
STR freezes the outputs while it is high, which is the opposite way round from a sample-and-hold trigger; leave it unpatched and the outputs follow every clock.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
